Name: Halloween Gifts
Author: Chloe1202
Description:
[font=Arial]🎃✨ [b]Chloe’s Halloween Gifts[/b] ✨🎃

Halloween outfit set including 5 shirts, 5 skirts, 4 hats, 4 hairstyles and 1 accessory (a pumpkin bag).
----------
﻿A little halloween gift for everyone🎁I was actually working on some winter outfits, but suddenly got inspired by Halloween and decided to draw this instead. It’s not my usual style, but I wanted to make something special for the holiday. BTW the fifth is Tomie Kawakami, I’m curious if anyone will notice haha👻✨Happy early Halloween!
[/font]-------------------------------
[color=#d5a6bd][b]HOW TO USE:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Install Fashion Sense: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969[/url]
[*]Buy the Hand Mirror from Pierre’s shop.
[*]Select the Hand Mirror in your toolbar and left-click your character to open the outfit menu.
[*]Use the icons to switch categories:
[/list][list=1]
[*]Left (top → bottom): Hair ✂️/ Accessory🕶️ / Hat👒 / Body👩🏻‍🦲
[*]Right (top → bottom): Top👚 / Bottom👖 / Sleeves🧤 / Shoes👟
[/list][list]
[*]Click the item icon and 🔍 search bar, then type the item you want to wear💖
[*]Note: If the color doesn’t match the preview, try setting the base color to 0 / 0 / 100.
[/list]----------
